method.summary: Pushes the edges of the Rectangle out by the horizontal and vertical values specified.

overload.summary: Pushes the edges of the Rectangle out by the horizontal and vertical values specified.

parameters.parameter: Value to push the sides out by.
Value to push the top and bottom out by.
